### OR Labs

An operations research web platform that I designed, built and deployed end to end. It hosts four interactive tools in English, Spanish and Catalan, free to use without signing up and with extended access for students. Front ends built with LLM-assisted development.

### Almaraz nuclear phase-out

Electricity-market model behind the Greenpeace Spain report *Cierre nuclear y transición energética: el caso de Almaraz* (2026), with Eloy Sanz (URJC). Wholesale prices driven by gas prices, with battery damping calibrated on CAISO data, comparing closure and extension scenarios for Almaraz I and II.

::: {.tags}
[Electricity markets]{.tag} [Scenario analysis]{.tag} [Storage]{.tag}
:::

::: {.card-links}
[Read the report →](https://es.greenpeace.org/es/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/02/Informe-cierre-Almaraz-pag.pdf)
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
[<i class="bi bi-droplet"></i>]{.pc-icon}

### Water–energy nexus of Catalonia

PhD project. An hourly simulation model integrating renewable generation, electricity demand, reservoirs and desalination, with multi-objective optimisation of transition scenarios (emissions, cost and water security). Proposes opportunistic desalination: desalinate when renewables are in surplus.

::: {.tags}
[Hourly simulation]{.tag} [Multi-objective]{.tag} [Water]{.tag}
:::

::: {.card-links}
[Code on GitHub →](https://github.com/vgarcica/water-energy-nexus-cat-model)
[Springer paper →](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-032-21811-7)
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
[<i class="bi bi-water"></i>]{.pc-icon}

Predictive model of the water stored in the reservoirs of Catalonia's internal river basins, developed as part of the PhD.

### PyGPSS-X

Discrete-event simulation engine that modernises GPSS semantics with drag-and-drop blocks. Queues, production lines and logistics.
